alertFilterMatchOnly.description: Only block if the alert-filter-regexp matches active alerts

alertFilterRegexp.description: alert names to ignore when checking for active alerts

alertFiringOnly.description: only consider firing alerts when checking for active alerts

blockingPodSelector.description: label selector identifying pods whose presence should prevent reboots

drainDelay.description: delay drain for this duration (default: 0, disabled)

drainGracePeriod.description: time in seconds given to each pod to terminate gracefully, if negative, the default value specified in the pod will be used (default: -1)

drainPodSelector.description: only drain pods with labels matching the selector (default: '', all pods)

drainTimeout.description: timeout after which the drain is aborted (default: 0, infinite time)

endTime.description: only reboot before this time of day (default "23:59")

forceReboot.description: force a reboot even if the drain fails or times out (default: false)

lockAnnotation.description: annotation in which to record locking node (default "weave.works/kured-node-lock")

lockReleaseDelay.description: hold lock after reboot by this amount of time (default 0, disabled)

lockTtl.description: force clean annotation after this amount of time (default 0, disabled)

metricsPort.description: port number where metrics will listen

postRebootNodeLabels.description: labels to add to nodes after uncordoning (default [])

preRebootNodeLabels.description: labels to add to nodes before cordoning (default [])

prometheusUrl.description: Prometheus instance to probe for active alerts

rebootSentinel.description: path to file whose existence signals need to reboot (default "/var/run/reboot-required")

skipWaitForDeleteTimeout.description: when time is greater than zero, skip waiting for the pods whose deletion timestamp is older than N seconds while draining a node (default: 0)

useRebootSentinelHostPath.description: not actually a flag, indicates if the sentinel should be mounted
